summary:
ENCORE CITY v2: the merged plan. My Island moves from a pastel toy island to a small harbour city. It opens at golden hour and turns into a neon stage at Showtime. This answers the parent's two complaints: 'babyish' and 'rigid / all houses identical'. The core rules, the economy and the save format stay the same. All catalogue changes are additive.

THE BIGGEST WINS, IN SHIP ORDER (P0):
1. Look, light and materials.
   - Golden hour replaces the pastel DAY preset as the default.
   - Crisp 0.05 bevels on architecture, with no ink hull on buildings.
   - Smoked-glass windows, a deeper toon ramp, v2 neon colours.
   - The UI becomes dark glass, with Unbounded and Outfit fonts and a re-voiced copy table.
2. Home shapes, a new style slot 'shape':
   - Classic cottage and City loft are both free and included.
   - City loft is the new default, so every save opens on the new look. One tap goes back to the cottage.
   - Paid shapes: Beach villa 650, Neon tower 950, Sky dome 1250.
   - The roof slot becomes each shape's 'crown', so every roof name stays true.
3. Seven collectable city buildings, kind 'fun', cat 'city': the 5 the parent named, plus 2 cheap 1x1 entry pieces.
   - Photo Booth 250, Boba Café 350, LED Screen Tower 450, Recording Studio 550, Dance Studio 950, Rooftop Hangout 1100, Concert Stage 1450.
   - Each has a tap act, 3 deterministic trims picked by uid, and no chance mechanics.
4. Organic island:
   - A new pure terrain3d.js bakes one heightfield with exact flat pads inside the cells.
   - It gives a seeded per-child coastline, cliffs, beaches, retaining walls and boardwalks.
   - There is no grid in play mode; the edit overlay is the only grid.
   - grid3d.js stays frozen.
5. De-babied characters:
   - Pets get smaller eyes, longer legs and a smirk.
   - The avatar becomes an idol-style chibi in a hoodie, with legs and sneakers.
   - The 4-point Spark Stick replaces the wand.
   - Five streetwear accessories are added; the crowd becomes silhouettes.
6. Variety everywhere, with no randomness at purchase:
   - Organic decor gets full yaw, non-uniform scale, a lean and a tint, all hashed from the uid.
   - Small decor gets a hashed yaw of -20/0/+20 degrees.
   - Buildings get 3 trims each; home shapes get 2 trims from the profile seed.
7. A layered city across the bay, placed where the camera can actually see it: media barges at z -6.9, a quay with an LED lip at z -8.2, and towers behind. A 'skyline' establishing shot runs on mount and at the stage encore.

P1 (ships if on time): ambient life (water taxis, catamarans, harbour swifts, floating lanterns at night), sea reflections of city lights, path auto-tiling, a gentle golden-to-blue-hour drift, the games' HUD skin.

BACKLOG: drizzle and haze weather, strolling island fans, Sky Rail and the quay crowd, the far-silhouette sky layer, Skate Bowl, Merch Pop-up, Treetop den and Split-level shapes, Bomber jacket, door_neon, detail_led, detail_deck, re-arranged island_day music.

CONFLICTS I RESOLVED:
- Backdrop: the art director's skyline at z -16..-22 is rejected. In every play pose it sits above the top of the frame (measured: the top ray meets the sea at z -8.6..-9.3). The terrain role's layered layout plus the skyline shot replaces it.
- surfaceY: changes to it are rejected. grid3d stays frozen, and hills come from off-cell terrain.
- Camera FOV: stays 30, not 32.
- Footprints and prices: the buildings role's, which were verified against canPlace.
- Act names: serve, snap, screen, record, dance, hangout, encore.
- Default shape: the art director's choice wins (the City loft is the default). The loft design merges the art director's loft with the buildings role's 'glass cube'.

Everything is procedural, original, kid-safe, ≤ 2 Hz, reduced-motion aware and inside the 2019-iPad budgets. Nothing awards points.

- Materials: crisp bevelled concrete, smoked glass, teak boardwalks, gunmetal rails, LED strips and screens.
- Golden hour is the default. Showtime is full night: indigo sky, magenta city glow, three sweeping cones, LED edges, the crew on stage.
- The cuteness dial moves from 'baby' to 'cool older sibling': smaller confident eyes, longer legs, less squash, witty copy.

- Neon stays under 8% of the frame at golden hour and under 15% at Showtime.

- Calibration at golden hour: lit Turf reads #4FA36A ±6% L. Tune only the key intensity.
- Shadows on MID/HIGH: ortho -13..13 × -9..9, bias -0.0005, normalBias 0.03; 1024² on MID, 2048² on HIGH; LOW uses blob shadows.
- Transition: 1.6 s inOutSine (0.25 s crossfade under reduced motion).
- 'City wakes up' ripple: lights fade in over 0.3 s, delayed 40 ms per cell of distance from the home. Never a pop.
- Ambient drift (P1): k_a = 0.12 + 0.12·cos(2πt/420 s), so golden hour eases toward blue hour. Edit mode eases to 0; reduced motion holds 0.12. Colours and intensities move; the direction never does.
- Photocard STUDIO preset: hemi Studio Sky / Studio Ground at 1.4; key Studio Key 2.2 from (-5, 8, 9); rim = member colour at 0.45; transparent clear over the dark CSS well.

FLASH SAFETY (test-enforced in every FREQS table):
- Nothing faster than 2 Hz (MAX_FLASH_HZ).
- Full-contrast LED chases ≤ 1.5 Hz (new LED_CHASE_HZ).
- Beat pulses ≤ 1.97 Hz (118 BPM) at ±35% brightness or less.
- Skyline windows switch at most once per ramp, with a 1.2 s fade.
- Beacons are 0.5 Hz sines.
- No full-screen luminance change over 20% within 0.5 s, no strobe, no full-screen white.
- Any brightness bloom (lens flash, screen wipe) at most once per 1.5 s per item.

MATERIALS:
- Toon: one shared program (cache key 'encore-toon'). Ramp moves from [110,165,215,255] to [64,128,200,255].
- Bevels: architecture (home, buildings, attractions, paths, decor) uses radius 0.05 × the smallest side, capped at 0.06, with 2 segments, at 1.0× real proportions. Organic pieces and characters keep 0.18 and props run 1.1×.
- Outlines: OUTLINE_KINDS becomes {pet, acc, avatar}, so houses and attractions lose the hull. Characters keep a hull of 0.009 in Midnight Ink, MID/HIGH only. The edit selection hull stays 0.02 to 0.03 Star Gold, pulsing at 1.5 Hz.

    - BANK (0.34–0.6): convex grass shoulder.
    - ROCK (headlands, the back and west edges, the meadow's tall west side): steep faceted Cliff Rock faces 0.35–0.6 tall with boulders. This, the meadow flanks and Lantern Islet are the 'hills'.
  - Beyond the coast: h = SEA_Y − 0.06 − 0.5·min(s, 1).
- Mesh:
  - Surface-nets shoreline; per quad, the diagonal with the smaller height difference; pad normals exactly (0, 1, 0).
  - Vertex colour from Turf, Turf Shade, Hill Moss and Leaf Lit blended by 2-octave world noise (2.6 u / 0.7 u, ±5% L, ±4° hue). Never a checker.
  - Drawn as ONE InstancedMesh(count 1) on the shared toon program, receiving shadows.
  - Casting scenery (walls, boulders, boardwalk posts, abutment) is a second merged mesh on MID/HIGH, merged into the terrain on LOW.
- Plinths: same logic, rendered as rounded risers (Teak top, Concrete skirt).
- Unlock rise: bake the new land on purchase confirm (cached per land signature, ≤ 4 combos). The new region's vertices rise in 1–5 bands with M.landRise delays while the old terrain stays, then swap in one frame. Reduced motion: instant swap plus a 0.25 s field crossfade. fx3d splash-ring delays are unchanged.
- Sea field (128×80, RGB8):
  - R = distance to the real coast, so foam hugs the organic shore.
  - G = signed distance to each locked region's FUTURE coast, so the hologram sandbar previews the exact shape. Fallback: the v1 squares.
  - B = lagoon factor in coves.
- SAFETY NET: env keeps the v1 tile renderer (with v2 colours and no checker) behind opts.terrain === false. It is used automatically if bake throws or exceeds 60 ms.

2) GRID VISIBILITY
- Play mode: no grid. No checker, no seams, no chamfer grooves, no sand-skirt squares.
- Ground dressing is world-space Poisson (r 0.32 on grass, 0.45 on sand), never per cell:
  - wildflower clumps of 5–12, clover, beach grass on the seam, shells and starfish only on sand with t > 0.4, pebbles and moss on rock
  - each piece: yaw 0–360°, scale 0.7–1.25, tint ±6%
  - it excludes occupied 0.86 cell interiors and path cells
- Edit/place mode: the edit3d overlay is the only grid.
  - Rounded dashed 0.9 squares on unlocked cells at pad height + 0.012, plus a faint Cloud White 0.07 fill. It fades in over 0.2 s (a cut under reduced motion).
  - Valid, invalid (1.5 Hz), entrance and select states are unchanged.
  - The light eases to k 0, the brightest. Life keeps going off-island.
- QA: SLIsland3D.debug.grid(true), and ?grid=1 under SL_WORLD_TRIAL.

3) STRUCTURES. Fixed and coast-generated; regenerated only on land change. EXCLUSION: every REGION_CELLS cell (locked too) dilated by 0.3 u stays clear.
- Boardwalk decks: 0.36 u wide, 0.06 above ground, posts every 0.6 u over water. Planks alternate Teak / Teak Light, ±4% per plank, 1 in 9 offset. Edge strip: off at golden hour start, Holo Blue in the dusk drift, member colour at Showtime.
- South Promenade: x −3..+3 at t ≈ 0.55 on the home south beach, with a small LED plaza where the beach is widest; Sunset Amber bollards on every 2nd span.
- NE Ferry Jetty: (3.8, −4.6) → (4.2, −5.8).
- Lantern Bridge abutment deck at (−3.2, −4.45).
- P1: Cove Pier (cove unlocked); Meadow Lookout deck plus stone stairs (meadow unlocked).
- Lantern Islet at (−8.0, −5.4): r 0.7, a 0.6-tall rock knoll with one palm. A pair of rock stacks at about (7.4, 5.6).
- Stage buoys stay at (±9.5, −6.5) and become LED ring buoys: torus R 0.4, Electric Violet.

4) THE CITY ACROSS THE BAY. Owner B2: world/island3d/city3d.js.
- Why this layout: with fov 30 and elevation 48°, the top of the frame meets the sea only at z −8.6 to −9.3, so the city is layered by what each pose can see.
- L0 MEDIA BARGES: always in frame. 3 pontoons at x −5.5, +0.5, +6.0, z −6.9, yawed toward the island centre. LED screens 1.5×0.65 at y 0.15–0.8 from the shared LED atlas, with an LED Cyan waterline. They bob at 0.2 Hz.
- L1 QUAY: superellipse |x/17|^4 + |(z + 0.6)/7.6|^4 = 1; the back runs flat at about z −8.2.
  - Quay Stone sea wall with a continuous LED Cyan lip (the city line that reads even when cropped).
  - Lamp dots every 0.8 u; ferry terminal at (6, −8); generic kiosks and pavilions 0.4–1.4 u tall.
  - It never copies the collectable buildings.
- L2 MID-RISES (2–4.5 u behind the quay, 1.8–4.5 tall) and L3 TOWERS (4.5–9 u behind, 4.5–9 tall).
  - Archetypes: needle, twist (7° per floor), ringed cylinder, twin with sky-bridge, stepped.
  - Tallest at the back centre, tapering to 55% at the flanks.
  - A hero tower (+30%) every ~3rd building, never two adjacent; neighbour heights differ by 12% or more; no two neighbours share an archetype.
  - Façade 1 of 5 Night Glass tones ±6%. The Signal Mast beacon is a 0.5 Hz sine.
- LANDMARKS:
  - Halo Wheel at (14.5, −6.2): d 3.2, 0.02 rev/s, a plain ring with dot lights and no capsules.
  - Lantern Bridge: island abutment (−3.2, −4.45) to quay (−3.2, −8.2). Deck 0.42 wide, arch rise 0.55, one leaning 2.1 u pylon, 5 cable pairs. LED edges in Holo Blue at dusk and the member colour at Showtime. The house light pole is nudged 0.6 u if it lands within 0.6 of the abutment.
- BUILD:
  - One static merged geometry, seed 'sl-city-v1', so siblings share one city. Counts: LOW 30, MID 60, HIGH 90.
  - One 'city' ShaderMaterial (+1 program):
    - half-lambert from the hemi/sun uniforms
    - procedural windows: floors 0.16 u, bays 0.12 u; lit when the hash < litFraction(k) = mix(0.3, 0.7, k); Window Warm or cool white, ≤ 8% neon
    - LED panels (EQ, gradient sweep, ♥ ★ ♪ ✦ marquee)
    - one hero board reading "<NAME>'S ISLAND ✦ SHOWTIME" via a 256×64 canvas drawn once
    - vertex animation for wheel spin and barge bob
    - own haze (35–110); emissive parts fogged at only 50%
  - LOW fallback if the programs are already at 12: toon instanced glass plus 'state' window strips.
  - Not pickable.
- P1 REFLECTIONS (in the sea shader's program): up to 4 / 6 / 10 light pillars from the barges, wheel and brightest towers, streaking toward uCamXZ, × the dusk level, branch-skipped where vXZ.y > −4.4. Plus a shimmer band along the quay lip. Sea plane grows to 160 u.
- BACKLOG: Sky Rail, quay crowd, far silhouette in the sky shader.
- Originality: no tower-on-hill-with-disc, no tapered supertall cone, no metal-blob plaza, no rainbow bridge, no capsule wheel. No brands.

5) LIGHT CYCLE
- Boot in DUSK (golden hour). The 'slwShowtime' key keeps its meaning: '1' = Showtime.
- The Showtime toggle and encores blend k to 1 over 1.6 s; encores return to DUSK.
- 'City wakes up' ripple: 40 ms per cell from the home, each light fading over 0.3 s.
- Showtime: 3 cones at 0.12 Hz, 120° apart, sweeping ±25°. Mounted on the LED buoys, plus the stage truss when bld_stage is placed (P1), otherwise the pole behind the house.
- P1 drift: k_a = 0.12 + 0.12·cos(2πt/420 s). Reduced motion holds 0.12.

6) AMBIENT LIFE. P1. Owner B3: world/island3d/life3d.js. Instanced, with no per-frame allocation and only moved instances touched.
- BOATS (LOW 2, MID 4, HIGH 5):
  - Water taxis on a Catmull-Rom loop: NE jetty → under the bridge mid-span → ferry terminal → back, at 0.35 u/s with 6 s eased stops.
  - 2 catamarans on the flanks at 0.12 u/s; the party boat is P2.
  - Bob ±0.02 at 0.3 Hz. V wakes via a uBoat[4] uniform (MID/HIGH).
  - Paths stay ≥ 0.8 u from coast and buoys and never enter the exclusion zone.
- HARBOUR SWIFTS (LOW 4 glide-only, MID 7, HIGH 10): figure-8 loops over the channel at y 2.2–3.4 (≥ 3.2 over the island). Flap 1.6 Hz for 1.5 s, then glide 2.5 s. They roost on the bridge pylon and quay rail at Showtime.
- FLOATING LANTERNS (LOW 8, MID 16, HIGH 24): from k 0.5, so in practice at Showtime. Rounded cube, cylinder or sphere bodies plus a glow from an env-owned ambient halo layer (capacity 48). 30% in the member colour. Curl-noise drift at 0.05 u/s; they gather round Lantern Islet.
- Reduced motion: everything moored, perched and still, which restores render-on-demand.
- BACKLOG: strolling island fans, weather.

7) VARIETY. Deterministic only, with nothing random at purchase.
- Organic decor:
  - jitter2: full yaw, non-uniform scale, a ±3° lean, foliage hue ±5°; idle amplitude ×0.8–1.2 by hash.
  - P1: the neighbour rule for same-id adjacency.
- Small decor: hashed yaw from {−20, 0, +20}.
- Houses, buildings, attractions and paths never get transform jitter.
- Buildings: 3 trims each by uid; home shapes: 2 trims by profile seed. Unique items, so this costs no extra draw calls.
- Paths (P1): auto-tile from the 4-neighbour mask into end, straight, corner, tee and cross pieces, with rounded inner corners. Stones and planks pick 1 of 3 layouts plus a rotation by hash.
- Boulders: 4 faceted bases × yaw × scale 0.6–1.6 × tint.
- City: per the archetype rules in section 4.
- Never mirror with negative instance scale.

8) CAMERA. Owner B10.
- FOV stays 30; fitDist, picking and edit tilt are unchanged.
- elevDefault 52 → 48; elevMin in play 40 → 34; edit stays 62.
- New stage-cam move 'skyline':
  - elev 14, yaw −16, target (cx, ty 2.0, cz − 1.5), zoom 0.8
  - hold 0.9 s, then ease 1.8 s inOutSine to the user view
  - replaces the mount reveal and also runs at the stage 'encore'
  - a drag ends it; reduced motion = a cut
- Showtime orbit: ±8° yaw plus an elevation dip of −6° (floor 40).
- Back-pan: when zoom > 1.2, the target may travel 2.5 u further toward −z (the city side only).

9) PERFORMANCE: env + terrain + city + life, worst case (Showtime, all land).

| | LOW | MID | HIGH |
|---|---|---|---|
| Draw calls | about 15 | about 22 | about 25 |
| Triangles | about 12k | about 30k | about 45k |
| Terrain | 1.4k | 5.5k | 12k |
| Scenery | 2.5k | 5k | 6k |
| Dressing | 1.5k | 3k | 4.5k |
| City | 5k | 11k | 17k |
| Life | 1.2k | 3k | 4.5k |

- Programs: +1 city (all tiers). Everything else uses toon, state, sprite, water or matcap.
- Textures: about +1.3 MB (field 61 KB, LED atlas and sign atlas 512 KB each, photo strip 128 KB, hero board 64 KB). Total stays under 8 MB.
- CPU:
  - terrain bake about 8 ms in Node, ≤ 35 ms on a 2019 iPad, run behind the 2D → 3D crossfade and on unlock confirm
  - city build ≤ 20 ms once
  - per frame ≤ 0.25 ms
- 7 placed buildings add ≤ 28 draws on MID. On LOW the scene merges their static shells per material (P1, only if the lab's max-island fixture exceeds 70 calls).
- The adaptive LADDER sheds 'life', then 'reflections', before 'cones'.
- env.info() reports calls and tris per layer.

Default-shape surprise: every existing save opens on the City loft, and a child who loved the cottage may be upset.
- Mitigation: the one-time toast with one-tap 'Back to the cottage', and all their walls, roof, door and details carry over.

LOW-tier budgets: 7 multi-mesh buildings plus the city plus life could push LOW past 70 draw calls or 60k tris.
- Mitigation: city 30 buildings on LOW, clouds and sleeves dropped, life is P1 and sheds first in LADDER, and a P1 LOW static-shell merge for buildings.
- Gate: the lab's max-island LOW measurement before ship.

Shader programs on LOW: the new 'city' ShaderMaterial is +1 against a cap of 12.
- Mitigation: shadow and outline programs are off on LOW; led and sign reuse the emoji-face basic+map program; the matcaps share one program; and the city has a toon+state fallback when renderer.info.programs is already at 12.

Terrain complexity: the EDT, blur, surface-nets and rise bands are new code on the critical visual path, with a bake budget of ≤ 35 ms on an iPad.
- Mitigation: the bake is pure and Node-tested with invariants, cached per land signature (≤ 4 combos), and runs behind the 2D → 3D crossfade.
- The v1 tile renderer stays as an automatic fallback if the bake throws or takes more than 60 ms.
- Rise bands can degrade to a single band.

Expected-red window: A1 re-points LOOK and adds ids before the owning B chunks update their models and tests, so some suites are red at the A-tip.
- Mitigation: the exact expected-red list is in coreChanges §6, each chunk keeps its own suites green against the A-tip, and only the integration tip must be fully green.
- Never deploy from an intermediate merge.

Golden-hour readability: a darker, warmer default may make small items and edit states harder to read for younger siblings, especially on LOW.
- Mitigation: calibrate lit Turf to #4FA36A; edit mode eases k to 0; the Cloud White grid fill; the Night Zenith floor of #0B0A1F.
- Check on the real iPad in both presets.

Originality and kid-safety drift: K-pop inspiration could creep toward real light-stick shapes, fandom colour pairs, choreography or teen-club vibes.
- Mitigation: the SIGN_WORDS whitelist test, the 4-point Spark Stick test, the ≥ 4-hue / ≤ 35% LED mix test, generic-moves-only dance clips, and the boba café (never a bar).
- The finger-heart emote is a generic gesture but can be swapped for a thumbs-up if the parent prefers.

Mixed-version window: an old cached client cannot see building cells and could place decor on them. Nothing is lost (normalize sends one item back to storage), but a child may be briefly confused.
- Mitigation: bump SL_WORLD_VER and CACHE_VERSION so the update window is short.

Fonts offline or slow: Unbounded and Outfit come from Google Fonts, and the sign atlas needs the font before drawing.
- Mitigation: display=swap and system-ui fallbacks; the atlas awaits document.fonts.load with a 1.5 s timeout and redraws once if the font arrives later; the existing service-worker runtime cache covers repeat loads.

Scope: 17 chunks plus the lead is large.
- Mitigation: explicit P0/P1/P2 tags. Life (B3), reflections, drift, path auto-tiling, the games skin (B14) and music (B15) can slip without blocking the ship.
- Backlog items (skate bowl, merch, treehouse, split-level, weather, strolling fans, Sky Rail) add no ids now, so nothing ships half-built.

Pet performs on buildings (gathers on entrance cells, a hop to the rooftop anchor) may target cells occupied by paths or other pets, or anchors that move after a building move.
- Mitigation: setAnchorFn resolves live; perform returns −1 and the building animates alone when no legal target exists; Node tests cover occupied and illegal cells.

Camera skyline shot: a 2.7 s establishing move on every mount could feel slow to a returning child.
- Mitigation: any drag or tap ends it early, it is skipped under reduced motion, and it can be limited to the first mount per session if testers find it repetitive.

Personal data in textures: the child's first name and initial appear on the LED tower, the hero board and the neon-tower sign.
- They are local only and never sent anywhere, but photocards and shop icons must use the non-personal variants (star field, ✦ only) so the shared icon cache holds no names.

Economy feel: adding about 9,870 ⭐ of new items could make older purchases feel devalued, or tempt big-balance siblings into an instant splurge.
- Prices sit in the existing session bands, the ≥ 300 confirm dialog applies, and savings goals work for every new item.
- The parent can adjust prices in CATALOG before the trial ends without any save impact.
